research_question: Does genuinely new, free, PIT-safe public CFTC trader-positioning information add incremental 1D/3D directional predictive content beyond a small fixed public-market baseline, strongly enough to justify escalating data acquisition toward paid forward-looking options or microstructure data?

new_public_data.pit_available_rule: Tuesday report positions become eligible only from report_date + 6 calendar days; merge backward-asof requires available_date <= origin_date.

maturity_rule: For a forecast at origin t, training rows require target_date < origin_date_t.
boundary_rule: Evaluation target_date must remain inside the evaluation period.

LEGACY5.legacy_nc_z52: current legacy_nc_net_share standardized by the previous up-to-52 weekly values, excluding current; require at least 26 previous values else NaN

DISAGG5.mm_z52: current mm_net_share standardized by the previous up-to-52 weekly values, excluding current; require at least 26 previous values else NaN

candidate_models.LEGACY_ONLY: LEGACY5 only; diagnostic only and cannot win the primary incremental gate
candidate_models.DISAGG_ONLY: DISAGG5 only; diagnostic only and cannot win the primary incremental gate

model_lock.family: training-only median imputation -> StandardScaler -> LogisticRegression L2

temporal_design.forward_rule: At every origin fit only on target-matured historical rows. 2025/2026 cannot select a COT representation, feature, model, or threshold.

benchmark: Causal expanding matured UP frequency; fallback 0.5 if fewer than 20 matured labels.

visible_persistence_classification.ROBUST_HOPE: Formation+bridge gate pass and BASE-relative Brier improvement is positive in both 2025 and available-2026.
visible_persistence_classification.WEAK_HOPE: Formation+bridge gate pass and BASE-relative Brier improvement is positive in exactly one of 2025 or available-2026.
visible_persistence_classification.NO_HOPE: Formation or bridge gate fails, or both visible periods are non-positive. Visible periods cannot rescue a pre-2025 failure.

decision_lock.ROBUST_HOPE: Paid option-surface and/or futures microstructure feasibility receives high priority under a separate PIT contract; V1.70B itself authorizes no paid purchase.
decision_lock.WEAK_HOPE: Paid forward-looking data may be evaluated as a research acquisition, but the free COT signal is not production evidence.
decision_lock.NO_HOPE: Do not tune COT features, clocks, z-window, model family, or thresholds after score. COT failure does not falsify paid option/microstructure information because those are different information classes.
